attchmntText: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Analyst /Institutional Investor Meet
voiceSummary: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited intimates that its officials held meetings with Invesco Asset Management on 19th November 2026 at 2:30 P.M. and with Investec Capital on 20th November 2026 at 9:45 A.M. Both meetings were conducted in person and were of the one-on-one type. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information was shared during these sessions. Additionally, no presentation was made at the aforesaid meetings. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about execution of an Asset Purchase Agreement between Dixon Technologies (India) Limited and Vimal Plast (India) Private Limited
voiceSummary: Dixon Technologies entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Vimal Plast on 16th November 2026. The company will acquire movable assets including moulds, R&D lab equipment, and machinery from Vimal. The total consideration is up to INR 49,75,00,000 excluding taxes. This acquisition is subject to satisfactory completion of conditions precedent. The transaction aims to enhance semi-automatic washing machine ODM capabilities. Dixon Technologies holds no shareholding in Vimal Plast. The parties are not related. This filing is under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations.
